source.text: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר זָקֵ֖ן שְׁמוּאֵ֑ל וַיָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת־בָּנָ֛יו שֹׁפְטִ֖ים לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when was old Samuel, and he made his sons judges over Israel.

en.L: And it happened, when Samuel was old, that he made his sons judges over Israel.
en.B: In his old age Samuel appointed his sons as judges over Israel.
en.R: When Samuel grew old, he made his sons judges to lead Israel.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando Samuel envejeció, puso a sus hijos como jueces sobre Israel.
es.B: Cuando Samuel llegó a viejo, nombró a sus hijos jueces sobre Israel.
es.R: Cuando Samuel envejeció, hizo que sus hijos fueran jueces para dirigir a Israel.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Samuel fut vieux, qu’il établit ses fils juges sur Israël.
fr.B: Devenu vieux, Samuel établit ses fils comme juges sur Israël.
fr.R: Quand Samuel est devenu vieux, il a nommé ses fils juges pour diriger Israël.

sw.L: Na ikawa, Samweli alipokuwa mzee, akawafanya wanawe kuwa waamuzi juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Samweli alipozeeka, aliwaweka wanawe kuwa waamuzi juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Samweli alipozeeka, aliwafanya wanawe kuwa waamuzi wa kuwaongoza Israeli.

vi.L: Khi Sa-mu-ên đã già, người lập các con trai mình làm thẩm phán trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Khi về già, Sa-mu-ên lập các con trai mình làm thẩm phán cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Khi Sa-mu-ên đã già, người lập các con trai mình làm thẩm phán để lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 늙었을 때, 그는 자기 아들들을 이스라엘의 사사로 세웠다.
ko.B: 사무엘은 늙자 자기 아들들을 이스라엘의 사사로 세웠다.
ko.R: 사무엘은 늙자 자기 아들들을 사사로 세워 이스라엘을 이끌게 했다.

decisions.choice: judges: leaders who governed Israel and settled its disputes
decisions.reason: The judges of the book of Judges were leaders raised up to rescue and govern Israel (Judges 2:16-18). Samuel himself judged Israel all his life, going round a circuit of towns (7:15-17). Here the word names the same kind of leadership, given to Samuel's sons.

decisions.choice: Samuel was old: he passed his leadership on to his sons
decisions.reason: Judges were raised up one by one, not by inheritance. Gideon refused to found a line of rulers (Judges 8:22-23). By appointing his sons, Samuel makes leadership pass within a family, and his age is the reason the elders give for asking for a king (verse 5).

decisions.choice: judges to lead Israel
decisions.reason: As in Judges, Readable adds "lead" so that "judges" is not taken to mean only judges in a law court.

decisions.choice: waamuzi
decisions.reason: The leaders of the book of Judges are "waamuzi" at every level, the Swahili name for that office; "mahakimu" would make them court magistrates only (m1).

decisions.choice: "thẩm phán" for the judges
decisions.reason: Leaders who governed and settled disputes (meaning decision); "thẩm phán" is the modern word, where "quan xét" belongs to the older translations.

decisions.choice: "사사"
decisions.reason: The judges led Israel and settled its disputes (m1); "사사", the title of the book of Judges, says both, while "재판관" says only the court.

source.text: וַיְהִ֞י שֶׁם־בְּנ֤וֹ הַבְּכוֹר֙ יוֹאֵ֔ל וְשֵׁ֥ם מִשְׁנֵ֖הוּ אֲבִיָּ֑ה שֹׁפְטִ֖ים בִּבְאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע׃

records.literal_gloss: And was [the] name of his son the firstborn Joel, and [the] name of his second Abijah; judges in Beersheba.

en.L: And the name of his firstborn son was Joel, and the name of his second [was] Abijah; [they were] judges in Beersheba.
en.B: His firstborn son was named Joel, and his second Abijah. They served as judges in Beersheba.
en.R: His oldest son was named Joel, and his second son was Abijah. They were judges in the town of Beersheba.

es.L: Y el nombre de su hijo primogénito era Joel, y el nombre del segundo [era] Abías; [eran] jueces en Beerseba.
es.B: Su hijo primogénito se llamaba Joel, y el segundo Abías. Ejercían como jueces en Beerseba.
es.R: Su hijo mayor se llamaba Joel, y el segundo, Abías. Eran jueces en la ciudad de Beerseba.

fr.L: Et le nom de son fils premier-né était Joël, et le nom de son second, Abiya ; [ils étaient] juges à Beer-Shéba.
fr.B: Son fils aîné s’appelait Joël, et le second Abiya. Ils exerçaient la fonction de juges à Beer-Shéba.
fr.R: Son fils aîné s’appelait Joël, et son deuxième fils Abiya. Ils étaient juges dans la ville de Beer-Shéba.

sw.L: Na jina la mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza lilikuwa Yoeli, na jina la wa pili [lilikuwa] Abiya; [walikuwa] waamuzi huko Beer-sheba.
sw.B: Mwanawe mzaliwa wa kwanza aliitwa Yoeli, na wa pili Abiya. Walihudumu kama waamuzi huko Beer-sheba.
sw.R: Mwanawe mkubwa aliitwa Yoeli, na mwanawe wa pili aliitwa Abiya. Walikuwa waamuzi katika mji wa Beer-sheba.

vi.L: Tên của con trưởng nam người là Giô-ên, và tên của con thứ hai [là] A-bi-gia; [họ là] thẩm phán tại Bê-e-Sê-ba.
vi.B: Con trưởng nam của người tên là Giô-ên, con thứ hai tên là A-bi-gia. Họ làm thẩm phán tại Bê-e-Sê-ba.
vi.R: Con trai cả của người tên là Giô-ên, con trai thứ hai là A-bi-gia. Họ làm thẩm phán tại thị trấn Bê-e-Sê-ba.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 맏아들의 이름은 요엘이고, 그의 둘째의 이름은 아비야였다. [그들은] 브엘세바에서 사사였다.
ko.B: 그의 맏아들의 이름은 요엘이고, 둘째의 이름은 아비야였다. 그들은 브엘세바에서 사사로 일했다.
ko.R: 사무엘의 맏아들은 요엘이었고, 둘째 아들은 아비야였다. 그들은 브엘세바라는 성읍에서 사사로 일했다.

decisions.choice: Joel and Abijah: names that confess Yahweh
decisions.reason: Joel means "Yahweh is God" and Abijah "Yahweh is my father". The sons bear names of faith, which makes their conduct in verse 3 all the sadder.

decisions.choice: Beersheba: a town in the far south of the land
decisions.reason: Beersheba lay at the southern edge of Israel; "from Dan to Beersheba" means the whole land (3:20). It was far from Ramah, Samuel's home, and from the towns of his own circuit, Bethel, Gilgal and Mizpah (7:16-17).

decisions.choice: They served as judges (Balanced); They were judges (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "judges in Beersheba". Balanced and Readable supply a verb to make a full sentence; Readable also says that Beersheba was a town.

decisions.choice: "Joël", "Abiya"
decisions.reason: "Joël" is the established French form; "Abiya" transcribes the name the way the Samuel terms note writes "Benaya" and "Tserouya", keeping the ending "-ya" that names Yahweh (m1).

decisions.choice: "Giô-ên" and "A-bi-gia"
decisions.reason: "Giô-ên" is the form of the Vietnamese Acts 2:16; "A-bi-gia" the usual Protestant form, also in Luke 1:5.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־הָלְכ֤וּ בָנָיו֙ בִּדְרָכָ֔יו וַיִּטּ֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַבָּ֑צַע וַיִּ֨קְחוּ־שֹׁ֔חַד וַיַּטּ֖וּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃פ

records.literal_gloss: But not walked his sons in his ways, and they turned aside after the gain, and took a bribe, and turned aside justice.

en.L: But his sons did not walk in his ways, and they turned aside after gain, and took bribes, and turned aside justice.
en.B: But his sons did not follow his ways. They turned aside after dishonest gain; they took bribes and bent justice.
en.R: But Samuel's sons did not live the way their father did. They were greedy for money. They took bribes and made unfair decisions.

es.L: Pero sus hijos no anduvieron en sus caminos, sino que se desviaron tras la ganancia, y aceptaron soborno, y torcieron el derecho.
es.B: Pero sus hijos no siguieron sus pasos. Se desviaron tras las ganancias deshonestas; aceptaban sobornos y torcían la justicia.
es.R: Pero los hijos de Samuel no vivían como su padre. Eran codiciosos. Aceptaban sobornos y tomaban decisiones injustas.

fr.L: Mais ses fils ne marchèrent pas dans ses voies ; ils se détournèrent vers le profit, et ils prirent des pots-de-vin, et ils firent dévier le droit.
fr.B: Mais ses fils ne suivirent pas son exemple. Ils se laissèrent attirer par le gain malhonnête, acceptèrent des pots-de-vin et faussèrent la justice.
fr.R: Mais les fils de Samuel ne vivaient pas comme leur père. Ils aimaient trop l’argent. Ils acceptaient des cadeaux pour favoriser quelqu’un et rendaient des jugements injustes.

sw.L: Lakini wanawe hawakutembea katika njia zake, bali walikengeuka wakifuata faida, wakapokea rushwa, wakapotosha haki.
sw.B: Lakini wanawe hawakufuata njia zake. Walikengeuka wakitafuta faida isiyo halali; walipokea rushwa na kupotosha haki.
sw.R: Lakini wana wa Samweli hawakuishi kama baba yao alivyoishi. Walikuwa na tamaa ya fedha. Walipokea rushwa na kutoa hukumu zisizo za haki.

vi.L: Nhưng các con trai người không bước đi trong đường lối người; họ chạy theo lợi lộc, nhận hối lộ và làm sai lệch công lý.
vi.B: Nhưng các con trai người không noi theo đường lối người. Họ chạy theo lợi bất chính, nhận hối lộ và bẻ cong công lý.
vi.R: Nhưng các con trai của Sa-mu-ên không sống như cha mình. Họ tham tiền. Họ nhận hối lộ và xử kiện bất công.

ko.L: 그러나 그의 아들들은 그의 길로 걷지 않고, 이익을 따라 빗나가서 뇌물을 받고 정의를 굽게 했다.
ko.B: 그러나 그의 아들들은 아버지의 길을 따르지 않았다. 그들은 부정한 이익을 좇아 뇌물을 받고 재판을 굽게 했다.
ko.R: 그러나 사무엘의 아들들은 아버지처럼 살지 않았다. 그들은 돈 욕심이 많았다. 그들은 뇌물을 받고 불공정하게 판결했다.

decisions.choice: his sons (the reading the scribes marked)
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) can be read "his son"; the reading the scribes marked in the margin (qere) is "his sons", which the printed text follows. The plural fits the plural verbs and the two sons named in verse 2, so the meaning is the same either way. Reviewers should check this against the Masoretic notes.

decisions.choice: walk in his ways: live as he lived
decisions.reason: A person's "ways" are the conduct of their life. Samuel ruled honestly and could later call the people to witness that he had taken no bribe (12:3-5); his sons did not follow him.

decisions.choice: took a bribe and turned aside justice: the very things the law forbids judges
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 16:19 tells judges, "You shall not turn aside justice ... and you shall not take a bribe" (see also Exodus 23:6-8). The sons break it word for word. The word for justice here returns in verses 9 and 11 for the "way" of the king.

decisions.choice: gain: profit got dishonestly
decisions.reason: The word means profit, often profit gained by violence or fraud. Moses was told to choose judges who hate such gain (Exodus 18:21).

decisions.choice: bent justice (Balanced); made unfair decisions (Readable)
decisions.reason: To "turn aside justice" is to twist a verdict away from what is right. Balanced keeps a picture close to the Hebrew; Readable says what it meant in practice.

source.text: וַיִּֽתְקַבְּצ֔וּ כֹּ֖ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הָרָמָֽתָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered themselves all [the] elders of Israel and came to Samuel to Ramah.

en.L: And all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.
en.B: So all the elders of Israel came together and went to Samuel at Ramah.
en.R: So all the leaders of Israel met together and went to see Samuel at his home in Ramah.

es.L: Y se reunieron todos los ancianos de Israel y vinieron a Samuel en Ramá.
es.B: Entonces todos los ancianos de Israel se reunieron y fueron a ver a Samuel en Ramá.
es.R: Entonces todos los líderes de Israel se reunieron y fueron a ver a Samuel a su casa en Ramá.

fr.L: Et tous les anciens d’Israël se rassemblèrent et vinrent vers Samuel à Rama.
fr.B: Alors tous les anciens d’Israël se réunirent et allèrent trouver Samuel à Rama.
fr.R: Alors tous les responsables d’Israël se sont réunis et sont allés voir Samuel chez lui, à Rama.

sw.L: Na wazee wote wa Israeli wakakusanyika, wakamjia Samweli huko Rama.
sw.B: Basi wazee wote wa Israeli wakakusanyika pamoja, wakaenda kwa Samweli huko Rama.
sw.R: Basi viongozi wote wa Israeli wakakutana pamoja, wakaenda kumwona Samweli nyumbani kwake huko Rama.

vi.L: Tất cả các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên nhóm họp lại và đến cùng Sa-mu-ên tại Ra-ma.
vi.B: Vậy tất cả các trưởng lão Y-sơ-ra-ên họp nhau lại và đến gặp Sa-mu-ên tại Ra-ma.
vi.R: Vậy tất cả các nhà lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên họp lại và đến gặp Sa-mu-ên tại nhà người ở Ra-ma.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘의 모든 장로가 모여서 라마에 있는 사무엘에게 왔다.
ko.B: 그래서 이스라엘의 모든 장로가 모여 라마에 있는 사무엘에게 갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘의 모든 지도자가 모여서 라마에 있는 사무엘의 집으로 찾아갔다.

decisions.choice: the elders of Israel: the heads of families and clans who spoke for the people
decisions.reason: The elders were senior men who led their clans and acted for the nation as a whole (4:3; Exodus 3:16). Their coming together shows that the request is the people's considered decision, not a passing complaint.

decisions.choice: Ramah: Samuel's home town
decisions.reason: Samuel was born in Ramah (1:1, 19), lived there and built an altar there, and judged Israel from it (7:17).

decisions.choice: leaders; at his home in Ramah
decisions.reason: Readable says "leaders" for "elders", since the word here is about their position, not their age, and adds that Ramah was Samuel's home (see m2).

source.text: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו הִנֵּה֙ אַתָּ֣ה זָקַ֔נְתָּ וּבָנֶ֕יךָ לֹ֥א הָלְכ֖וּ בִּדְרָכֶ֑יךָ עַתָּ֗ה שִֽׂימָה־לָּ֥נוּ מֶ֛לֶךְ לְשָׁפְטֵ֖נוּ כְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they said to him, Look, you are old, and your sons not walk in your ways; now appoint for us a king to judge us like all the nations.

en.L: And they said to him, "Look, you are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways. Now appoint for us a king to judge us, like all the nations."
en.B: They said to him, "You are old, and your sons do not follow your ways. So now appoint a king to judge us, as all the nations have."
en.R: They said to him, "You are old now, and your sons do not live the way you do. So choose a king to lead us, just as all the other nations have."

es.L: Y le dijeron: «Mira, tú has envejecido, y tus hijos no andan en tus caminos. Ahora, pon sobre nosotros un rey que nos juzgue, como todas las naciones».
es.B: Le dijeron: «Tú ya eres anciano, y tus hijos no siguen tus pasos. Así que nombra ahora un rey que nos juzgue, como lo tienen todas las naciones».
es.R: Le dijeron: «Ya eres viejo, y tus hijos no viven como tú. Así que escoge un rey que nos gobierne, como lo tienen todas las demás naciones».

fr.L: Et ils lui dirent : « Voici, tu es vieux, et tes fils ne marchent pas dans tes voies. Maintenant, établis sur nous un roi pour nous juger, comme toutes les nations. »
fr.B: Ils lui dirent : « Tu es vieux, et tes fils ne suivent pas ton exemple. Établis donc maintenant sur nous un roi pour nous gouverner, comme en ont toutes les nations. »
fr.R: Ils lui ont dit : « Tu es vieux maintenant, et tes fils ne vivent pas comme toi. Alors choisis un roi pour nous diriger, comme toutes les autres nations en ont un. »

sw.L: Nao wakamwambia, "Tazama, wewe umezeeka, na wanao hawatembei katika njia zako. Basi sasa tuwekee mfalme atuhukumu, kama mataifa yote."
sw.B: Wakamwambia, "Wewe umezeeka, na wanao hawafuati njia zako. Basi sasa tuwekee mfalme atuamue, kama mataifa yote yalivyo nao."
sw.R: Wakamwambia, "Sasa wewe ni mzee, na wanao hawaishi kama wewe. Kwa hiyo tuchagulie mfalme atuongoze, kama mataifa mengine yote yalivyo nao."

vi.L: Họ nói với người: "Kìa, ông đã già, và các con trai ông không bước đi trong đường lối ông. Vậy bây giờ xin ông lập cho chúng tôi một vua để xét xử chúng tôi, như mọi dân tộc."
vi.B: Họ nói với người: "Ông đã già, còn các con trai ông không noi theo đường lối ông. Vậy bây giờ xin ông lập một vua để xét xử chúng tôi, như các dân tộc khác."
vi.R: Họ nói với người: "Ông bây giờ đã già, còn các con trai ông không sống như ông. Vậy xin ông chọn một vua để lãnh đạo chúng tôi, như tất cả các dân tộc khác."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그에게 말했다. "보십시오, 당신은 늙었고, 당신의 아들들은 당신의 길로 걷지 않습니다. 이제 모든 민족처럼 우리를 다스릴 왕을 우리에게 세워 주십시오."
ko.B: 그들이 사무엘에게 말했다. "어른께서는 늙으셨고, 아드님들은 어른의 길을 따르지 않습니다. 그러니 이제 다른 모든 민족처럼 우리를 다스릴 왕을 세워 주십시오."
ko.R: 그들이 사무엘에게 말했다. "어른께서는 이제 늙으셨습니다. 그런데 아드님들은 어른처럼 살지 않습니다. 그러니 다른 모든 민족처럼 우리를 이끌 왕을 뽑아 주십시오."

decisions.choice: to judge us: to govern and lead us
decisions.reason: The people use the verb that described the judges' work: to rule, settle disputes and lead in war (verse 20). They ask for the same leadership, but from a king and his line.

decisions.choice: a king like all the nations: the request Deuteronomy foresaw
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 17:14 expects Israel to say, "I will set a king over me, like all the nations that are around me." The law allows a king, but only one whom Yahweh chooses and who lives under the law (Deuteronomy 17:15-20). Israel had been called to be set apart from the nations (Leviticus 20:26; Numbers 23:9); now the elders want to be like them.

decisions.choice: look ... now: the request rests on the facts just stated
decisions.reason: "Look" points to Samuel's age and his sons' conduct; "now" draws the conclusion. The elders present their request as the answer to a real problem.

decisions.choice: Look left out (Balanced, Readable); choose a king to lead us (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Look" here only draws attention, which English does by tone. Readable says "lead" for "judge", as in verse 1, and "choose" for "appoint".

decisions.choice: "pour nous juger" (Literal); "pour nous gouverner" (Balanced); "pour nous diriger" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to govern and lead as well as to settle disputes (m1). French "juger" today means only the second, so Balanced and Readable say what the elders want from a king; Literal keeps "juger", which links the request to the judges of verse 1.

decisions.choice: atuhukumu (L); atuamue (B); atuongoze (R)
decisions.reason: "To judge" here means to govern and lead (m1); the three levels keep the steps used for Samuel's judging (7:15).

decisions.choice: the elders call Samuel "ông" and themselves "chúng tôi"
decisions.reason: Leaders of the people speaking with respect to the old prophet and judge; "ông" is respectful without the court language they ask for.

decisions.choice: The elders call Samuel "어른" with the honorific (B, R); Literal keeps "당신" for the Hebrew "you"
decisions.reason: The elders speak to the aged prophet and judge with full respect; "당신" sounds distant or rude in spoken Korean, so Balanced and Readable use the respectful "어른께서".

source.text: וַיֵּ֤רַע הַדָּבָר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמְר֔וּ תְּנָה־לָּ֥נוּ מֶ֖לֶךְ לְשָׁפְטֵ֑נוּ וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And was evil the thing in [the] eyes of Samuel when they said, Give to us a king to judge us. And prayed Samuel to Yahweh.

en.L: And the thing was evil in the eyes of Samuel when they said, "Give us a king to judge us." And Samuel prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But Samuel was displeased when they said, "Give us a king to judge us," and he prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Samuel did not like it when they said, "Give us a king to lead us." So he prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y la cosa fue mala a los ojos de Samuel cuando dijeron: «Danos un rey que nos juzgue». Y Samuel oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero a Samuel le desagradó que dijeran: «Danos un rey que nos juzgue», y oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: A Samuel no le gustó que le dijeran: «Danos un rey que nos gobierne». Así que oró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et la chose fut mauvaise aux yeux de Samuel, quand ils dirent : « Donne-nous un roi pour nous juger. » Et Samuel pria {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais cette demande déplut à Samuel, quand ils dirent : « Donne-nous un roi pour nous gouverner. » Et il pria {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Samuel n’a pas aimé les entendre dire : « Donne-nous un roi pour nous diriger. » Alors il a prié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na jambo hilo likawa baya machoni pa Samweli waliposema, "Tupe mfalme atuhukumu." Na Samweli akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini Samweli hakupendezwa waliposema, "Tupe mfalme atuamue," naye akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Samweli hakupenda waliposema, "Tupe mfalme atuongoze." Kwa hiyo akamwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Điều ấy là xấu trong mắt Sa-mu-ên khi họ nói: "Hãy cho chúng tôi một vua để xét xử chúng tôi." Sa-mu-ên cầu nguyện cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Nhưng Sa-mu-ên không hài lòng khi họ nói: "Hãy cho chúng tôi một vua để xét xử chúng tôi," và người cầu nguyện cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên không vui khi họ nói: "Hãy cho chúng tôi một vua để lãnh đạo chúng tôi." Vì vậy người cầu nguyện cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 "우리를 다스릴 왕을 우리에게 주십시오" 하고 말했을 때, 그 일이 사무엘의 눈에 악했다. 그래서 사무엘이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다.
ko.B: 그러나 "우리를 다스릴 왕을 주십시오" 하는 그들의 말이 사무엘에게는 못마땅했다. 그래서 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다.
ko.R: 그들이 "우리를 이끌 왕을 주십시오" 하고 말하자, 사무엘은 그 말이 싫었다. 그래서 사무엘은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도했다.

decisions.choice: the thing was evil in the eyes of Samuel: it displeased him
decisions.reason: "Evil in the eyes of" means that someone judged a thing bad. The same words describe what displeases Yahweh (Judges 2:11). Samuel is troubled by the request for a king, not only by the remark about his age.

decisions.choice: give us a king: the request in its barest form
decisions.reason: The narrator repeats the people's words in short, with "give" in place of "appoint" (verse 5). What stays is the core of it: a king, to judge them.

decisions.choice: Samuel prayed: he brought the matter to Yahweh
decisions.reason: Samuel is shown as one who prays for Israel (7:5, 8-9; 12:19, 23). He does not answer the elders himself but waits for Yahweh's word.

decisions.choice: was displeased (Balanced); did not like it (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable give its sense in everyday words.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל שְׁמַע֙ בְּק֣וֹל הָעָ֔ם לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־יֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אֹֽתְךָ֙ מָאָ֔סוּ כִּֽי־אֹתִ֥י מָאֲס֖וּ מִמְּלֹ֥ךְ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to Samuel, Listen to [the] voice of the people in all that they say to you, for not you they have rejected, but me they have rejected from being king over them.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Listen to the voice of the people in all that they say to you, for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} from being king over them.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Listen to the people in everything they are saying to you. It is not you they have rejected; it is {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} they have rejected as their king.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to Samuel, "Do what the people are asking you to do. They have not turned away from you. They have turned away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They do not want {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to be their king.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo a Samuel: «Escucha la voz del pueblo en todo lo que te digan, porque no te han rechazado a ti, sino que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han rechazado a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, para que no reine sobre ellos.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «Escucha al pueblo en todo lo que te está diciendo. No es a ti a quien han rechazado; es a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a quien han rechazado como su rey.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo a Samuel: «Haz lo que el pueblo te pide. No se han apartado de ti. Se han apartado de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. No quieren que yo sea su rey.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Écoute la voix du peuple dans tout ce qu’ils te diront, car ce n’est pas toi qu’ils ont rejeté, mais c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’ils ont rejeté, pour que je ne règne pas sur eux.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à Samuel : « Écoute le peuple dans tout ce qu’il te dit. Ce n’est pas toi qu’ils ont rejeté ; c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qu’ils ont rejeté comme roi.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à Samuel : « Fais ce que le peuple te demande. Ce n’est pas de toi qu’ils se détournent. C’est de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Ils ne veulent plus que je sois leur roi.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Isikilize sauti ya watu katika yote wanayokuambia, kwa maana hawakukataa wewe, bali wamenikataa {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nisiwe mfalme juu yao.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Wasikilize watu katika kila jambo wanalokuambia. Si wewe waliyekukataa; ni {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} waliyenikataa kuwa mfalme wao.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Samweli, "Fanya kile watu wanachokuomba. Hawajakuacha wewe. Wameniacha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. Hawataki niwe mfalme wao.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy nghe theo tiếng của dân trong mọi điều họ nói với ngươi, vì không phải họ từ bỏ ngươi, nhưng họ từ bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, không cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm vua trên họ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy nghe theo mọi điều dân chúng nói với con. Không phải họ từ bỏ con, mà chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Đấng họ từ bỏ, không muốn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm vua của họ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Sa-mu-ên: "Hãy làm theo điều dân chúng xin. Họ không phải từ bỏ con. Họ từ bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Họ không muốn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm vua của họ nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "백성이 네게 하는 모든 말을 들어주어라. 그들이 버린 것은 네가 아니라, 나를 버려 내가 그들 위에 왕이 되지 못하게 한 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "백성이 네게 하는 말을 모두 들어주어라. 그들이 버린 것은 네가 아니다. 그들은 나를 버려 내가 그들의 왕이 되지 못하게 한 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 사무엘에게 말씀하셨다. "백성이 해 달라는 대로 해 주어라. 그들은 너를 버린 것이 아니다. 그들은 나를 버렸다. 그들은 내가 자기들의 왕이 되는 것을 원하지 않는다.

decisions.choice: listen to the voice of the people: do what they ask
decisions.reason: To "listen to someone's voice" often means to agree to what they ask (Genesis 21:12). Yahweh tells Samuel to give the people a king; the command comes three times (verses 7, 9, 22).

decisions.choice: they have rejected me from being king over them: Yahweh was Israel's king
decisions.reason: Israel's true king was Yahweh (Exodus 15:18; Deuteronomy 33:5). Gideon refused to rule because "Yahweh will rule over you" (Judges 8:23), and Samuel later says the people asked for a king "when Yahweh your God was your king" (12:12). Wanting a king like the nations is a turning away from Yahweh's rule.

decisions.choice: rejected: refused, cast aside
decisions.reason: The verb means to reject with contempt or refuse. It is used of despising Yahweh's laws (Leviticus 26:15), and later of Yahweh's rejecting Saul when Saul had rejected his word (15:23, 26).

decisions.choice: turned away from; do not want me to be their king
decisions.reason: Readable uses plainer words for "rejected" and makes "from being king over them" its own sentence.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}
decisions.reason: Swahili adds the free pronoun "mimi" to the object marker "-ni-" to carry the Hebrew contrast "not you ... but me" (m2); as a free pronoun spoken by God it takes the span.

decisions.choice: God calls Samuel "ngươi" (L) and "con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note sets for God speaking to a person: Literal keeps the plain second person, Balanced and Readable the warmth of the relationship.

source.text: כְּכָֽל־הַמַּעֲשִׂ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֗וּ מִיּוֹם֩ הַעֲלֹתִ֨י אֹתָ֤ם מִמִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ וְעַד־הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיַּ֣עַזְבֻ֔נִי וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים כֵּ֛ן הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִׂ֖ים גַּם־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: According to all the deeds which they have done from the day I brought up them from Egypt and until this day, and they have forsaken me and served other gods, so they [are] doing also to you.

en.L: According to all the deeds that they have done from the day I brought them up from Egypt and until this day, and they have forsaken {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and served other gods, so they are doing also to you.
en.B: They are doing to you just what they have always done since the day I brought them up from Egypt: to this very day they have forsaken {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and served other gods.
en.R: Ever since the day I brought them out of Egypt, they have left {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and worshiped other gods. They are still doing it today. Now they are doing the same thing to you.

es.L: Conforme a todas las obras que han hecho desde el día en que los saqué de Egipto hasta el día de hoy, pues {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han abandonado y han servido a otros dioses, así hacen también contigo.
es.B: Te están haciendo a ti lo mismo que han hecho siempre desde el día en que los saqué de Egipto: hasta el día de hoy {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han abandonado y han servido a otros dioses.
es.R: Desde el día en que los saqué de Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} han dejado y han adorado a otros dioses. Todavía lo siguen haciendo hoy. Ahora te están haciendo lo mismo a ti.

fr.L: Selon toutes les œuvres qu’ils ont faites, depuis le jour où je les ai fait monter d’Égypte et jusqu’à ce jour, et ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné et ont servi d’autres dieux, ainsi font-ils aussi envers toi.
fr.B: Ils agissent envers toi exactement comme ils l’ont toujours fait depuis le jour où je les ai fait monter d’Égypte : jusqu’à ce jour, ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné pour servir d’autres dieux.
fr.R: Depuis le jour où je les ai fait sortir d’Égypte, ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont abandonné et ont adoré d’autres dieux. Ils le font encore aujourd’hui. Maintenant, ils font la même chose avec toi.

sw.L: Kulingana na matendo yote waliyoyafanya tangu siku ile nilipowapandisha kutoka Misri mpaka leo, wakaniacha {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} na kutumikia miungu mingine, ndivyo wanavyokutendea na wewe pia.
sw.B: Wanakutendea wewe kama walivyozoea kutenda tangu siku ile nilipowapandisha kutoka Misri: mpaka leo wameniacha na kutumikia miungu mingine.
sw.R: Tangu siku ile nilipowatoa Misri, wameniacha na kuabudu miungu mingine. Bado wanafanya hivyo hata leo. Sasa wanakutendea wewe jambo lile lile.

vi.L: Theo mọi việc họ đã làm từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem họ lên khỏi Ai Cập cho đến ngày nay, họ đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và phục vụ các thần khác, thì họ cũng làm như vậy với ngươi.
vi.B: Họ đang đối xử với con đúng như cách họ vẫn làm từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem họ lên khỏi Ai Cập: cho đến tận ngày nay họ vẫn lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và phục vụ các thần khác.
vi.R: Từ ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem họ ra khỏi Ai Cập, họ đã lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và thờ các thần khác. Đến hôm nay họ vẫn làm như vậy. Bây giờ họ cũng đang làm điều đó với con.

ko.L: 내가 그들을 이집트에서 이끌어 올린 날부터 오늘날까지 그들이 행한 모든 일, 곧 나를 버리고 다른 신들을 섬긴 것처럼, 그들이 너에게도 그렇게 하고 있다.
ko.B: 그들은 내가 그들을 이집트에서 이끌어 낸 날부터 늘 해 오던 대로 너에게도 하고 있다. 오늘날까지 그들은 나를 버리고 다른 신들을 섬겨 왔다.
ko.R: 내가 그들을 이집트에서 데리고 나온 날부터 그들은 나를 버리고 다른 신들을 섬겼다. 오늘날까지도 그렇게 하고 있다. 이제 그들은 너에게도 똑같이 하고 있다.

decisions.choice: according to all ... so also to you: Samuel is treated as Yahweh has been
decisions.reason: The verse compares the two. As the people have treated Yahweh all through their history, so they now treat his prophet. Samuel shares in Yahweh's rejection.

decisions.choice: from the day I brought them up from Egypt until this day: the whole history of Israel
decisions.reason: Yahweh sums up the story since the exodus as one of repeated unfaithfulness, as the book of Judges tells it (Judges 2:11-13; 10:6-14).

decisions.choice: forsaken me and served other gods: abandoned Yahweh for the worship of other gods
decisions.reason: To "serve" a god is to worship it. These are the words used for Israel's sin throughout Judges (Judges 2:12-13; 10:13).

decisions.choice: They are doing to you just what they have always done
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the main point, what the people are doing to Samuel, first, and then gives the history it is compared with.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקוֹלָ֑ם אַ֗ךְ כִּֽי־הָעֵ֤ד תָּעִיד֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְהִגַּדְתָּ֣ לָהֶ֔ם מִשְׁפַּ֣ט הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִמְלֹ֖ךְ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And now listen to their voice; only surely warn you will warn them and tell to them [the] way of the king who will reign over them.

en.L: And now, listen to their voice. Only you shall solemnly warn them, and you shall tell them the way of the king who will reign over them."
en.B: So now, do as they ask. But you must warn them solemnly and tell them the ways of the king who will reign over them."
en.R: So do what they ask. But warn them strongly. Tell them how the king who rules over them will treat them."

es.L: Y ahora, escucha su voz. Solamente adviérteles solemnemente y declárales el proceder del rey que reinará sobre ellos».
es.B: Así que ahora haz lo que te piden. Pero adviérteles con toda seriedad y explícales cómo actuará el rey que reinará sobre ellos».
es.R: Así que haz lo que te piden. Pero adviérteles con firmeza. Diles cómo los va a tratar el rey que los gobierne».

fr.L: Et maintenant, écoute leur voix. Seulement, tu les avertiras solennellement, et tu leur feras connaître le droit du roi qui régnera sur eux. »
fr.B: Maintenant donc, accède à leur demande. Mais tu dois les avertir solennellement et leur faire connaître la manière d’agir du roi qui régnera sur eux. »
fr.R: Fais donc ce qu’ils demandent. Mais avertis-les sérieusement. Dis-leur comment le roi qui régnera sur eux va les traiter. »

sw.L: Basi sasa isikilize sauti yao. Ila hakika utawaonya kwa makini, na kuwaeleza njia ya mfalme atakayetawala juu yao."
sw.B: Basi sasa, fanya wanavyoomba. Lakini lazima uwaonye kwa makini na kuwaeleza mienendo ya mfalme atakayewatawala."
sw.R: Basi fanya wanavyoomba. Lakini waonye kwa nguvu. Waeleze jinsi mfalme atakayewatawala atakavyowatendea."

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, hãy nghe theo tiếng họ. Chỉ có điều ngươi phải long trọng cảnh cáo họ, và cho họ biết đường lối của vua sẽ cai trị trên họ."
vi.B: Vậy bây giờ, hãy làm theo điều họ xin. Nhưng con phải long trọng cảnh cáo họ, và cho họ biết cách vua sẽ cai trị họ."
vi.R: Vậy hãy làm theo điều họ xin. Nhưng hãy cảnh cáo họ thật nghiêm. Hãy cho họ biết vua cai trị họ sẽ đối xử với họ ra sao."

ko.L: 그러니 이제 그들의 말을 들어주어라. 다만 너는 그들에게 엄히 경고하고, 그들 위에 다스릴 왕의 방식을 그들에게 알려 주어라."
ko.B: 그러니 이제 그들의 말대로 해 주어라. 그러나 너는 그들에게 엄히 경고하고, 그들을 다스릴 왕이 어떤 권리를 내세울지 알려 주어라."
ko.R: 그러니 그들이 원하는 대로 해 주어라. 그러나 그들에게 단단히 경고하여라. 그들을 다스릴 왕이 그들을 어떻게 대할지 말해 주어라."

decisions.choice: the way of the king: what a king will regularly do and claim as his due
decisions.reason: The word usually means judgment or justice (verse 3), or a ruling or law. But it can also mean the regular practice of a group, as in "the way of the priests" in 2:13, which also describes taking from the people by force. What Samuel goes on to describe (verses 11-17) is not a law that limits the king but what kings will do: take, again and again. So the sense is the king's practice, the demands he will make as if by right. Some take the phrase as "the rights of the king", a formal statement of his powers; Samuel does later write down "the way of the kingdom" in a book (10:25), which may be such a charter. The word also carries irony: Samuel's sons twisted justice, and the king's "justice" will be taking.

decisions.choice: the king who will reign over them: set against the law of the king in Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 17:14-20 sets limits on Israel's king: he must not gather many horses, many wives, or much silver and gold for himself, and he is to read the law all his life so that he does not raise himself above his fellow Israelites. Samuel's warning describes a king with none of those limits, who takes for himself (verses 11-17).

decisions.choice: only ... surely warn: permission with a solemn condition
decisions.reason: "Only" limits what Yahweh has just allowed. The verb "warn" is doubled for emphasis; it means to warn formally, as a witness who can later be pointed to (Deuteronomy 8:19; 1 Kings 2:42).

decisions.choice: the way of the king (Literal); the ways of the king (Balanced); how the king ... will treat them (Readable)

decisions.choice: "le droit du roi" (Literal); "la manière d’agir du roi" (Balanced)

decisions.choice: the way of the king: as in verse 9
decisions.reason: What follows is the king's practice, the demands he will make as if by right. See verse 9.

decisions.choice: he will take: the key word of Samuel's speech
decisions.reason: The verb "take" comes again and again (verses 11, 13, 14, 16), and "take a tenth" twice more (verses 15, 17). The king the people want is above all one who takes. The list moves from their sons and daughters to their land, their harvest, their servants and animals, and at last to the people themselves (verse 17).

decisions.choice: chariots, horsemen and runners: a standing royal army and guard
decisions.reason: Chariots and horses were the costly core of a king's army, the very thing Deuteronomy 17:16 tells Israel's king not to multiply. Men running ahead of a king's chariot were a sign of royal rank (2 Samuel 15:1; 1 Kings 1:5). The word for chariot is singular in Hebrew but stands for the king's whole chariot force.

decisions.choice: put to work for himself
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the king will "set them for himself" in his chariots. Balanced makes clear that this is service the king requires of them.

decisions.choice: Some will drive his chariots or ride his horses.
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the long Hebrew sentence into short ones and says what the sons will do with the chariots and horses.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:sus hijos|vuestros hijos}} and the like through Samuel's speech (verses 11-18)
decisions.reason: Samuel speaks to the whole people, so every "your" and "you" is plural and takes the plural-you setting. With the ustedes default, "sus hijos" could also mean the king's sons; the span keeps the possessor clear as the people.

decisions.choice: atawachukua
decisions.reason: Samuel's speech turns on "he will take" (m2); Swahili keeps one verb, "kuchukua", through verses 11-17 at every level so the repetition can be heard.

decisions.choice: "bắt" for "he will take", repeated through verses 11-17
decisions.reason: The key word of Samuel's speech (meaning decision); "bắt" says taking people by force, and the Vietnamese keeps one verb for people and "lấy" for property, so the repetition is still heard.

decisions.choice: Each verse of the list (verses 11-12) is closed as its own Korean sentence
alternatives: one Korean sentence across the two verse markers, as the English Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: A Korean sentence ends with its verb, so the list that runs on from verse 11 into verse 12 is cut at the verse marker and verse 12 starts with its own subject.

decisions.choice: commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties: officers over army units

Saul later asks whether David would make his men "commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds" (22:7).

decisions.choice: plow his plowing and reap his harvest: forced labor on the king's land
decisions.reason: The king will own estates of his own and make free Israelites work them. Solomon later raised forced labor from all Israel (1 Kings 5:27; 12:4).

decisions.choice: weapons of war and the equipment of his chariots: arms and gear made in the king's workshops
decisions.reason: The first phrase names weapons in general; the second the fittings and gear of chariots. The king's war machine will be built by the labor of Israel's sons.

decisions.choice: some ... others
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lists the tasks one after another. Balanced supplies "some" and "others" to show that the sons will be divided among them.

decisions.reason: A king's palace needed many workers. Daughters would be taken from their families to serve the court, as sons were taken to serve the army (verses 11-12).

decisions.choice: to make perfumes for him, and to cook and bake for him
decisions.reason: Readable turns the names of the tasks into verbs and adds "for him", for whom the work is done.

source.text: וְאֶת־שְׂ֠דֽוֹתֵיכֶם וְאֶת־כַּרְמֵיכֶ֧ם וְזֵיתֵיכֶ֛ם הַטּוֹבִ֖ים יִקָּ֑ח וְנָתַ֖ן לַעֲבָדָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And your fields and your vineyards and your olive groves, the good [ones], he will take, and give to his servants.

en.L: And your fields and your vineyards and your olive groves, the best [ones], he will take and give to his servants.
en.B: The best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves he will take and hand over to his officials.
en.R: He will take your best fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his officials.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sus campos|vuestros campos}} y {{plural_you:sus viñas|vuestras viñas}} y {{plural_you:sus olivares|vuestros olivares}}, los mejores, los tomará y los dará a sus siervos.
es.B: Lo mejor de {{plural_you:sus campos|vuestros campos}}, de {{plural_you:sus viñas|vuestras viñas}} y de {{plural_you:sus olivares|vuestros olivares}} lo tomará y se lo entregará a sus oficiales.
es.R: Tomará {{plural_you:sus mejores campos|vuestros mejores campos}}, viñas y olivares, y se los dará a sus oficiales.

fr.L: Et vos champs, et vos vignes, et vos oliveraies, les meilleurs, il les prendra et les donnera à ses serviteurs.
fr.B: Il prendra le meilleur de vos champs, de vos vignes et de vos oliveraies pour le donner à ses officiers.
fr.R: Il prendra vos meilleurs champs, vos meilleures vignes et vos meilleures oliveraies et il les donnera à ses officiers.

sw.L: Na mashamba yenu na mashamba yenu ya mizabibu na mashamba yenu ya mizeituni, yale mazuri, atayachukua na kuwapa watumishi wake.
sw.B: Mashamba yenu, mashamba ya mizabibu na mashamba ya mizeituni yaliyo bora atayachukua na kuwapa maafisa wake.
sw.R: Atachukua mashamba yenu bora, mizabibu yenu na mizeituni yenu, na kuwapa maafisa wake.

vi.L: Ruộng đồng, vườn nho và vườn ô-liu của anh em, những cái tốt nhất, vua sẽ lấy và ban cho các đầy tớ của vua.
vi.B: Vua sẽ lấy những ruộng đồng, vườn nho và vườn ô-liu tốt nhất của anh em mà ban cho các quần thần của mình.
vi.R: Vua sẽ lấy những ruộng đồng, vườn nho và vườn ô-liu tốt nhất của anh em mà ban cho các quan chức của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 밭과 포도원과 올리브 밭 가운데 가장 좋은 것들을 그가 빼앗아 자기 신하들에게 줄 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 너희 밭과 포도원과 올리브 밭 가운데 가장 좋은 것을 빼앗아 자기 신하들에게 줄 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 너희의 가장 좋은 밭과 포도원과 올리브 밭을 빼앗아 자기 신하들에게 줄 것이다.

decisions.choice: your fields ... he will take: the family land Yahweh gave
decisions.reason: Each family's land was its inheritance from Yahweh and was not to pass out of the family for good (Leviticus 25:23; Numbers 36:7). A king who takes land breaks that order, as Ahab later did with Naboth's vineyard (1 Kings 21:1-16).

decisions.choice: his servants: the king's courtiers and officers
decisions.reason: Here the word names the men who serve the king at court and in his army. Saul later reminds his men that he is the one who can give them fields and vineyards (22:7).

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: The word Literal renders "servants" here means the king's court officials, so Balanced and Readable say "officials", as the term list for these books sets out.

decisions.choice: "ses serviteurs" (Literal); "ses officiers" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note settles for the king's servants: the courtiers and officers of the king (m2).

decisions.choice: "sus siervos" (L); "sus oficiales" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note: the king's servants who are his court officials (m2) are "siervos" at Literal and "oficiales" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: watumishi wake (L); maafisa wake (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: the king's servants are "watumishi wa mfalme" at Literal and "maafisa wa mfalme" at Balanced and Readable, since they are his courtiers and officers (m2).

decisions.choice: "các đầy tớ của vua" (L); "các quần thần" (B); "các quan chức" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for the king's servants: Literal keeps "servants", Balanced the court word, Readable the plain "officials".

decisions.choice: "신하들"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for the king's servants; "신하" is a king's official, so one word serves every level.

source.text: וְזַרְעֵיכֶ֥ם וְכַרְמֵיכֶ֖ם יַעְשֹׂ֑ר וְנָתַ֥ן לְסָרִיסָ֖יו וְלַעֲבָדָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And your seeds and your vineyards he will tithe, and give to his eunuchs and to his servants.

en.L: And your grain and your vineyards he will tithe, and give [it] to his eunuchs and to his servants.
en.B: He will take a tenth of your grain and of your grape harvest and give it to his court officials and his servants.
en.R: He will take a tenth of your grain and grapes and give it to his officials and servants.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sus sementeras|vuestras sementeras}} y {{plural_you:sus viñas|vuestras viñas}} diezmará, y [lo] dará a sus eunucos y a sus siervos.
es.B: Se quedará con la décima parte de {{plural_you:su grano|vuestro grano}} y de {{plural_you:su vendimia|vuestra vendimia}}, y se la dará a los funcionarios de su corte y a sus siervos.
es.R: Se quedará con la décima parte de {{plural_you:su grano|vuestro grano}} y de {{plural_you:sus uvas|vuestras uvas}}, y se la dará a sus funcionarios y a sus siervos.

fr.L: Et vos semences et vos vignes, il en prélèvera la dîme, et il [la] donnera à ses eunuques et à ses serviteurs.
fr.B: Il prélèvera le dixième de vos grains et de vos vendanges pour le donner à ses hauts fonctionnaires et à ses serviteurs.
fr.R: Il prendra le dixième de vos céréales et de votre raisin pour le donner à ses fonctionnaires et à ses serviteurs.

sw.L: Na nafaka zenu na mashamba yenu ya mizabibu atayatoza sehemu ya kumi, na kuwapa matowashi wake na watumishi wake.
sw.B: Atachukua sehemu ya kumi ya nafaka yenu na ya mavuno ya zabibu zenu na kuwapa maafisa wa ikulu yake na watumishi wake.
sw.R: Atachukua sehemu moja ya kumi ya nafaka yenu na zabibu zenu na kuwapa maafisa na watumishi wake.

vi.L: Hạt giống và vườn nho của anh em, vua sẽ thu một phần mười, và ban cho các hoạn quan và các đầy tớ của vua.
vi.B: Vua sẽ thu một phần mười lúa gạo và hoa lợi vườn nho của anh em mà ban cho các triều thần và quần thần của mình.
vi.R: Vua sẽ lấy một phần mười lúa và nho của anh em mà ban cho các quan chức và đầy tớ của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 곡식과 너희 포도원의 십분의 일을 거두어 자기 내시들과 신하들에게 줄 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 너희 곡식과 포도 수확의 십분의 일을 거두어 자기 궁정 관리들과 신하들에게 줄 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 너희 곡식과 포도의 십분의 일을 거두어 자기 관리들과 신하들에게 줄 것이다.

decisions.choice: he will tithe: the king takes a tenth as if it were his own
decisions.reason: The tenth of the land's produce belonged to Yahweh and was given to the Levites, or eaten before Yahweh with the poor (Leviticus 27:30-32; Numbers 18:21; Deuteronomy 14:22-29). The king will claim a tenth for himself.

decisions.choice: eunuchs: royal officials, perhaps castrated men
decisions.reason: The word can mean a man who has been castrated, as palace servants often were in the ancient Near East, or more broadly a high court official. Potiphar, who had a wife, is called by this word (Genesis 37:36; 39:1). Here it most likely names the king's officers in general.

decisions.choice: your seeds: the grain grown from your sowing
decisions.reason: The plural of "seed" here means the crops of the fields, set beside the produce of the vineyards.

decisions.choice: grain; grape harvest (Balanced); court officials and servants
decisions.reason: Literal says "grain" for "seeds" and keeps "vineyards"; Balanced and Readable name what is taken from the vineyards, the grapes. Balanced says "court officials" for the first word and keeps "servants" for the second, so that the two groups stay distinct.

decisions.choice: matowashi (L); maafisa wa ikulu (B); maafisa (R)
decisions.reason: "Towashi" is the Swahili word for a eunuch; Literal keeps it, while Balanced and Readable say officials, as the English does, since the word may simply mean a royal official (m2).

decisions.choice: "hoạn quan" (L); "triều thần" (B); "quan chức" (R) for *sarisim*
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: Literal keeps "eunuchs", with the meaning decision's doubt; Balanced and Readable say court officials.

decisions.choice: "내시들" (L); "궁정 관리들" (B); "관리들" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: Literal keeps the word's first sense, and Balanced and Readable say "officials", which is what it often means.

source.text: וְאֶת־עַבְדֵיכֶם֩ וְֽאֶת־שִׁפְח֨וֹתֵיכֶ֜ם וְאֶת־בַּחוּרֵיכֶ֧ם הַטּוֹבִ֛ים וְאֶת־חֲמוֹרֵיכֶ֖ם יִקָּ֑ח וְעָשָׂ֖ה לִמְלַאכְתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And your male slaves and your female slaves and your young men, the good [ones], and your donkeys he will take, and use [them] for his work.

en.L: And your male slaves and your female slaves, and your young men, the best [ones], and your donkeys he will take and put [them] to his work.
en.B: He will take your male and female servants, the best of your young men, and your donkeys, and put them to work for himself.
en.R: He will take your servants, both men and women, and your strongest young men and your donkeys. He will make them all work for him.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sus esclavos|vuestros esclavos}} y {{plural_you:sus esclavas|vuestras esclavas}}, y {{plural_you:sus jóvenes|vuestros jóvenes}}, los mejores, y {{plural_you:sus asnos|vuestros asnos}} tomará y [los] pondrá a su trabajo.
es.B: Tomará a {{plural_you:sus siervos|vuestros siervos}} y {{plural_you:sus siervas|vuestras siervas}}, a los mejores de {{plural_you:sus jóvenes|vuestros jóvenes}} y {{plural_you:sus asnos|vuestros asnos}}, y los pondrá a trabajar para él.
es.R: Tomará a {{plural_you:sus siervos|vuestros siervos}}, hombres y mujeres, y a {{plural_you:sus jóvenes|vuestros jóvenes}} más fuertes y {{plural_you:sus burros|vuestros burros}}. A todos los hará trabajar para él.

fr.L: Et vos esclaves et vos servantes, et vos jeunes gens, les meilleurs, et vos ânes, il les prendra et les emploiera à son ouvrage.
fr.B: Il prendra vos serviteurs et vos servantes, l’élite de vos jeunes gens, ainsi que vos ânes, et il les fera travailler pour lui.
fr.R: Il prendra vos serviteurs, hommes et femmes, vos jeunes gens les plus forts et vos ânes. Il les obligera tous à travailler pour lui.

sw.L: Na watumwa wenu wa kiume na watumwa wenu wa kike, na vijana wenu, walio bora, na punda wenu atawachukua na kuwatumikisha katika kazi yake.
sw.B: Atawachukua watumishi wenu wa kiume na wa kike, vijana wenu walio bora, na punda wenu, na kuwatumikisha kwa kazi zake.
sw.R: Atawachukua watumishi wenu, wanaume kwa wanawake, na vijana wenu wenye nguvu kuliko wote, na punda wenu. Atawafanya wote wamfanyie kazi.

vi.L: Tôi trai, tớ gái của anh em, và những thanh niên tốt nhất của anh em, cùng lừa của anh em, vua sẽ bắt và dùng [chúng] vào công việc của vua.
vi.B: Vua sẽ bắt tôi trai tớ gái của anh em, những thanh niên tốt nhất và lừa của anh em, để làm việc cho vua.
vi.R: Vua sẽ bắt đầy tớ nam nữ của anh em, những thanh niên khỏe mạnh nhất và lừa của anh em. Vua sẽ bắt tất cả phải làm việc cho vua.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 남종과 여종과 너희 젊은이들 가운데 가장 좋은 자들과 너희 나귀들을 빼앗아 자기 일에 부릴 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 너희의 남종과 여종과 가장 뛰어난 젊은이들과 나귀들을 빼앗아 자기 일을 시킬 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 너희의 남종과 여종, 가장 힘센 젊은이들과 너희 나귀들을 데려갈 것이다. 그리고 그들을 모두 자기를 위해 일하게 할 것이다.

decisions.choice: your young men (the Hebrew text)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "your cattle", which in Hebrew differs by one letter and would fit beside "your donkeys". The Hebrew text, "your young men", is kept; it also makes sense in a list of workers, and the meaning of the verse is the same: the king takes labor.

decisions.choice: your male slaves and female slaves: the workers of a household
decisions.reason: Many Israelite households had slaves, owned rather than hired (Exodus 21:2-11). The king will take even them for his own service.

decisions.choice: his work: the king's projects and labor
decisions.reason: The word means work or labor of any kind. It will be used of the king's building works and their forced labor (1 Kings 5:30; 9:23).

decisions.choice: male and female servants
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "slaves"; Balanced and Readable say "servants", as the style guide sets out, since the point here is their work, not their slavery.

source.text: צֹאנְכֶ֖ם יַעְשֹׂ֑ר וְאַתֶּ֖ם תִּֽהְיוּ־ל֥וֹ לַעֲבָדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Your flock he will tithe, and you, you will be to him for slaves.

en.L: Your flocks he will tithe, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
en.B: Of your flocks he will take a tenth, and you yourselves will become his slaves.
en.R: He will take one out of every ten of your sheep and goats. And you yourselves will become his slaves.

es.L: {{plural_you:Sus rebaños|Vuestros rebaños}} diezmará, y {{plural_you:ustedes mismos serán|vosotros mismos seréis}} sus esclavos.
es.B: De {{plural_you:sus rebaños|vuestros rebaños}} se quedará con la décima parte, y {{plural_you:ustedes mismos llegarán|vosotros mismos llegaréis}} a ser sus esclavos.
es.R: Se quedará con una de cada diez de {{plural_you:sus ovejas y cabras|vuestras ovejas y cabras}}. Y {{plural_you:ustedes mismos serán|vosotros mismos seréis}} sus esclavos.

fr.L: Votre petit bétail, il en prélèvera la dîme, et vous, vous deviendrez ses esclaves.
fr.B: Il prélèvera le dixième de vos troupeaux, et vous-mêmes, vous deviendrez ses esclaves.
fr.R: Il prendra un mouton ou une chèvre sur dix. Et vous-mêmes, vous deviendrez ses esclaves.

sw.L: Kondoo na mbuzi wenu atawatoza sehemu ya kumi, nanyi wenyewe mtakuwa watumwa wake.
sw.B: Atachukua sehemu ya kumi ya kondoo na mbuzi wenu, nanyi wenyewe mtakuwa watumwa wake.
sw.R: Atachukua mmoja kati ya kila kondoo na mbuzi kumi mlio nao. Nanyi wenyewe mtakuwa watumwa wake.

vi.L: Bầy chiên dê của anh em, vua sẽ thu một phần mười, còn chính anh em sẽ làm nô lệ cho vua.
vi.B: Vua sẽ thu một phần mười bầy chiên dê của anh em, và chính anh em sẽ trở thành nô lệ của vua.
vi.R: Cứ mười con chiên con dê của anh em thì vua lấy một. Và chính anh em sẽ trở thành nô lệ của vua.

ko.L: 그가 너희 양 떼의 십분의 일을 거둘 것이고, 너희 자신은 그의 종이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그는 너희 양 떼의 십분의 일을 거두어 갈 것이고, 너희 자신은 그의 종이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그는 너희 양과 염소를 열 마리에 한 마리씩 가져갈 것이다. 그리고 너희 자신은 그의 노예가 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: you will become his slaves: back to what Yahweh freed them from
decisions.reason: Yahweh brought Israel out of "the house of slaves" (Exodus 20:2) and said that the Israelites are his own slaves and must not be sold as slaves (Leviticus 25:42). Samuel's list ends where it has been heading: not only their goods but the people themselves will belong to the king.

decisions.choice: you yourselves: the pronoun is stressed
decisions.reason: The pronoun "you" is written out in addition to the verb, setting the people themselves against the flocks and fields just listed.

decisions.choice: flock: sheep and goats
decisions.reason: The word covers both sheep and goats kept together in one flock.

decisions.choice: slaves
decisions.reason: Here slavery itself is the point: the warning recalls Israel's slavery in Egypt. So every level keeps "slaves", as the style guide asks where "servant" would change the meaning.

decisions.choice: "esclaves" at every level
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note keeps "esclave" at every level where slavery itself is the point; Samuel warns that the people will go back to what the LORD freed them from in Egypt (m1).

decisions.choice: watumwa
decisions.reason: Here the point is slavery itself, a return to what the LORD freed them from (m1), so every level says "watumwa", as the English says "slaves".
The Korean notes keep "종" for *ʿeved* and "노예" where slavery itself is meant; here it is the loss of freedom Yahweh once ended (m1), which Readable says plainly.

source.text: וּזְעַקְתֶּם֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא מִלִּפְנֵ֣י מַלְכְּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּ֖ם לָכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־יַעֲנֶ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will cry out in the day that because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, and not will answer Yahweh you in the day that.

en.L: And you will cry out in that day because of your king whom you have chosen for yourselves, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not answer you in that day."
en.B: When that day comes, you will cry out because of the king you have chosen for yourselves, but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not answer you then."
en.R: A day will come when you cry out for help because of the king you chose. But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not answer you."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:clamarán|clamaréis}} en aquel día a causa de {{plural_you:su rey|vuestro rey}}, que {{plural_you:ustedes se han escogido|vosotros os habéis escogido}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no {{plural_you:les|os}} responderá en aquel día».
es.B: Cuando llegue aquel día, {{plural_you:clamarán|clamaréis}} a causa del rey que {{plural_you:se han escogido|os habéis escogido}}, pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no {{plural_you:les|os}} responderá entonces».
es.R: Llegará un día en que {{plural_you:clamarán|clamaréis}} pidiendo ayuda por causa del rey que {{plural_you:escogieron|escogisteis}}. Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no {{plural_you:les|os}} responderá».

fr.L: Et vous crierez en ce jour-là à cause de votre roi que vous vous serez choisi, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne vous répondra pas en ce jour-là. »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, vous crierez à cause du roi que vous vous serez choisi, mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne vous répondra pas. »
fr.R: Un jour viendra où vous appellerez au secours à cause du roi que vous avez choisi. Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne vous répondra pas. »

sw.L: Nanyi mtalia siku ile kwa sababu ya mfalme wenu mliyejichagulia, wala {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawajibu siku ile."
sw.B: Siku ile itakapofika mtalia kwa sababu ya mfalme mliyejichagulia, lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawajibu wakati huo."
sw.R: Siku moja mtalia mkiomba msaada kwa sababu ya mfalme mliyemchagua. Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatawajibu."

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy anh em sẽ kêu la vì cớ vua mà anh em đã chọn cho mình, nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không đáp lời anh em trong ngày ấy."
vi.B: Khi ngày ấy đến, anh em sẽ kêu la vì cớ vua mà anh em đã chọn cho mình, nhưng lúc ấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không đáp lời anh em."
vi.R: Sẽ có ngày anh em kêu cứu vì cớ vua mà anh em đã chọn. Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ không đáp lời anh em."

decisions.choice: in that day ... in that day: the verse is framed by the same phrase
decisions.reason: The repeated "in that day" ties the cry and the silence to one coming time of trouble.

decisions.choice: cry out for help

decisions.reason: The people repeat their wish, now with "we also" stressed, in the very words Deuteronomy foresaw (Deuteronomy 17:14). It is the opposite of Israel's calling to be different from the nations (Leviticus 20:26).

decisions.reason: Yahweh had fought for Israel (Exodus 14:14; Deuteronomy 1:30), most recently with thunder against the Philistines when Samuel prayed (7:10). The people now want a visible king to lead them in war.

decisions.choice: go out before us: lead us into battle
decisions.reason: To "go out and come in before" the people means to lead them in war (18:16; Numbers 27:17).

decisions.choice: spoke them in the ears of Yahweh: told Yahweh directly
decisions.reason: To speak "in the ears of" someone is to say it to them in person. Samuel brings the people's words to Yahweh, as he brought Yahweh's words to the people (verse 10).

decisions.reason: Verse 10 said Samuel told the people "all the words of Yahweh"; now he tells Yahweh "all the words of the people". Samuel stands between them as go-between.

decisions.choice: repeated it to (Balanced); told ... all of it (Readable)

decisions.choice: listen to their voice and make a king for them: Yahweh's third command
decisions.reason: For the third time Yahweh tells Samuel to grant the people's request (verses 7, 9). The verb "make reign" comes from the same root as "king".

decisions.choice: the men of Israel ... go each to his city: the elders are sent home
decisions.reason: "The men of Israel" are the elders who came to Ramah (verse 4). Samuel sends them home without naming a king. The story of how Yahweh chooses Saul follows (9:1-10:24).

decisions.choice: city: a town of any size
decisions.reason: The word names any walled settlement, large or small.

decisions.choice: Do as they ask, and give them a king
decisions.reason: As in verses 7 and 9, "listen to their voice" means to grant what they ask. Balanced and Readable say "give them a king" for "make a king reign over them".

decisions.choice: the leaders of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says "leaders" because the men meant are the elders of verse 4 (see m2).
